items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: Axelix – open-source platform to solve pains of Java Developers
items.contentSnippet:
I know that Java & Spring Boot are not fashionable these days, but I've spent years developing Java applications on the server side. And I think I know a lot of problems in overall SDLC of Java & Spring Boot apps in production.
So, with a small team, we've decided to create a tool for that. The exact features or problems solved, or will this problem be solved, or how do this/that - let's get into the comments.
To be clear, we want to make the tool Open Core (if we are to be precise in wording).

items.contentSnippet:

Apparently, it's really hard to work without LINQ after you got used to it, so I decided to add it to my language!

items.title: Show HN: Cyber, every hack in one place and does my code share the same flaw?
items.contentSnippet:
There's been too many hacks and not enough coverage. Incidents across different industries have been scattered and we also need to spend time prompting or digging manually to see what the exploit was.
Cyber collates this all in one place and is open source so experts from various industries can add relevant sources or make tweaks to the algorithm, code: https://github.com/askgina/cyber
With all the details on the hack and exploit in one place, you can point your agent at it to scan your own repo
